title: Repository Profile
description: Repository profile: naming prefix + build variants. Mutable path segments and file layout are NOT encoded here; they come from the absolute --op-dir at run time.

name.description: Profile identifier; also matched against op_dir path segments for repo identification.

artifacts_ignore.description: Build-artifact globs excluded from git-diff product collection and rollback.

precision_debug_commit.description: Automatic precision-debug commit scope. Patterns are relative to op_dir; include is an allowlist and exclude narrows it. Framework-protected debug/build exclusions are always applied in addition.

include.description: Allowed production-file globs. Empty/absent uses source-file safety defaults.

exclude.description: Additional repository-specific globs excluded from automatic commits.

build_variants.description: Project sub-trees, each selected by match_prefix against the op_dir relative path.

eval_prepare.description: Repo-level one-shot build steps run before cann-bench eval (NOT per-op — no match_prefix): fixed eval-framework components kernel_eval hard-depends on (e.g. cann_bench_utils anti-cheat warmup/cache_clean + its _C). Empty/absent = no eval-prepare. (step-82 决策1=C)

scaffolding.description: Operator invocation protocol (single authority). 'supported' lists the protocols the repo can build; 'selected' is the one this profile uses. selected must be in supported (enforced at load). Every consumer (codegen registration, smoke probe, deploy/precision call, cann-bench glue) reads 'selected' — the single knob.

selected.description: The protocol this profile uses; must be one of 'supported'.

match_prefix.description: Repo-relative prefix that decides which build an operator belongs to. Empty string = catch-all fallback.

default_reference_root.description: Fallback reference-operator search root; per-run overridable/appendable via --reference.

stages.description: Ordered compile stages; only enabled ones run.

clean_dirs.description: Dirs (relative to the build cwd, glob-allowed) removed on a clean rebuild to force CMake reconfigure — so a newly-added operator is collected into _C.abi3.so (P96: INTERNAL cache + file(GLOB) without CONFIGURE_DEPENDS). Triggered by Deployer.deploy(clean_build=True). Empty/absent = no clean (default).

role.description: Stage role (D6-2). 'build' compiles → artifacts; 'install_runtime'/'install_python' install to the per-op opp/python dir; 'smoke' verifies the operator is callable per codegen_manifest.callable_target. Defaults to 'build'.

cwd.description: Working directory for this stage, relative to repo root.

command_template.description: Command template; formatted with {full_op_name}, {chip_version}, and (for deploy roles) {per_op_opp_dir}/{per_op_python_dir}/{run_pkg}/{whl_pkg}.
